description: Newest remote job postings from We Work Remotely's public RSS feed: title, company (from the title), region, category, job type, link, publish time. The feed has no salary field. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_jobspresso when you need Newest remote jobs from Jobspresso's public job feed; jobs_wantedly when you need Newest job postings from Wantedly's public projects API. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
